title: AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.14380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many real-world tasks require LLM agents to interact with their environments over long execution horizons. Errors that occur early in execution may propagate through both the agent context and environment state, and their effects may be difficult to reverse through subsequent actions. Existing methods mainly seek to reduce such errors through plan refinement and safety checks but provide little support after errors occur. To enable recovery during long-horizon execution, we present AgentRewind, a runtime recovery framework that records aligned checkpoints of the agent context and controlled environment, allowing agents to return to an earlier state and resume execution with information from previous attempts. We also construct MettleBench, a benchmark for evaluating task completion and partial progress on long-horizon engineering assignments containing a series of related requirements. translated_title: AgentRewind：面向长周期LLM代理的可恢复执行机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14380v1 公告类型：新 摘要：许多现实世界任务要求LLM代理在长时间执行周期中与环境交互。执行早期发生的错误可能会通过代理上下文和环境状态传播，且其影响可能难以通过后续行动逆转。现有方法主要通过计划细化和安全检查来减少此类错误，但在错误发生后提供的支持很少。为了在长周期执行期间实现恢复，我们提出了AgentRewind，一个运行时恢复框架，它记录代理上下文和受控环境的对齐检查点，使代理能够返回早期状态并利用先前尝试的信息恢复执行。我们还构建了MettleBench，一个基准测试，用于评估包含一系列相关需求的长时间工程任务中的任务完成和部分进展。跨任务、多种模型、执行环境的实验表明...
tldr: AgentRewind通过记录代理上下文与环境状态的对齐检查点，使长周期LLM代理在出错后能回退并利用历史信息恢复执行，同时引入MettleBench基准来评估此类任务的完成度。
en_tdlr: AgentRewind enables recoverable execution for long-horizon LLM agents by recording aligned checkpoints of agent context and environment, allowing rollback and resume with prior attempt information, and introduces MettleBench for evaluating such tasks.
